meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审一遍已完成的改动，在交付前盯住目标、约束、代码质量与安全隐患
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚完成一批改动，准备交付却想先确认没有遗漏问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just finished changes and want a final check before handing off the PR

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会自己在真实界面上手动跑一遍 QA(逐条记录命令、预期、实测、证据),再只派一个 gate reviewer 子代理,按目标、约束、代码质量、安全、遗漏上下文和 QA 证据审计,最后给出 QA 矩阵与通过/不通过结论。
howto.when: 在 PR 交接之前,或用户明确要求审查已完成的工作时进入。手动 QA 只要有一行失败,就直接报 REVIEW FAILED,不再启动 gate reviewer。

say.text: 帮我审一下这次完成的改动
say.note: 先手动 QA,再启动一个 gate reviewer

say.text: PR 交接前先跑一轮门禁审查
say.note: QA 全通过才会派审查者

say.text: 我已手动 QA 过,派一个 gate reviewer 看这份 diff
say.note: 审查目标、约束与 QA 证据

howto.what_en: Claude first runs manual QA on the real surface itself, recording commands, expectations, observations and artifacts, then spawns exactly one gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context and QA evidence, and returns a QA matrix plus a pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Before a PR handoff, or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work. A single failing QA row ends the review as REVIEW FAILED and the gate reviewer is not launched.

say_en.text: Review the work I just finished
say_en.note: Manual QA first, then one gate reviewer

say_en.text: Run a gate review before I hand off this PR
say_en.note: A reviewer is spawned only after QA passes

say_en.text: I did manual QA already, send one gate reviewer over this diff
say_en.note: Audits goal, constraints and QA evidence
